title: NativeOntologyImportItem
description: One definition an import source states, with what applying it would do to the target.

kind.description: What the item is. A rule is any axiom other than a named subclass link or an object property assertion between two named concepts.

status.description: NEW and UPDATE carry a change set operation. ALREADY_EXISTS matches a stored definition. DUPLICATE repeats an earlier item of the same source. SKIPPED names a reason in `reason` and carries no operation.

id.description: Derived from what the item states, so it is the same in every preview of one source and a selection survives a second preview.

label.description: What a reader calls the item: a display name, or the sentence of a relationship or rule.

iri.description: IRI of the concept or property, or of the subject of a relationship or rule.

detail.description: For UPDATE, what changes, for example `Description: none to A customer.`.

reason.description: Why the item is DUPLICATE or SKIPPED.

warning.description: A finding applying the item would cause, for example a disjointness clash. The item stays selectable.

conceptIds.description: Concepts the warning names, the clashing concept first.

dependsOnIris.description: IRIs of the NEW concepts of this same import that the item states a fact about. A relationship or rule applies only with every one of them.

operationId.description: The change set operation that applies this item. Absent for ALREADY_EXISTS, DUPLICATE, and SKIPPED.
